authorization_scope_observed: deploy and observe the read-only readiness probe only. No live trading, no arming, no campaign approval, no change to any financial risk limit. Nothing outside that was done.

running.digest_unchanged: no strategy knob moved across any deploy in this cycle

submitted.note: append-only idempotency ledger of every client order id ever submitted; never pruned, so its size is a lifetime count and not open-order state

actual_readiness_output.remaining_blocker: HALT_NOT_ASSERTED -- correct and expected. The remote latch reads CLEAR; submissions are currently blocked by NOT_ARMED, not by the latch. Asserting the latch is a real operator step before any arm switch, not a formality.

a_defect_the_probe_found_in_ITSELF.why_it_was_wrong: my docstring claimed each row-book 'holds an order whose fate is not yet settled'. True of live_orders, pending_terminal and quarantine; FALSE of `submitted`, which record_submit writes for every client order id ever sent, which nothing anywhere pops or deletes, which backs already_submitted(coid) duplicate suppression, and which lives on a volume that outlives the process. Its size is the account's lifetime submission count.
a_defect_the_probe_found_in_ITSELF.consequence_if_unfixed: the gate could never have passed again, so the arm switch it exists to authorize would have been blocked for ever
a_defect_the_probe_found_in_ITSELF.how_I_got_it_wrong: I reasoned about `submitted` by analogy with its neighbours in the same state dict instead of reading how it is written
a_defect_the_probe_found_in_ITSELF.fix: moved to EVIDENCE_ONLY_BOOKS -- still reported with its count and a note saying what it is, and unable to block
nothing_lost_and_pinned_on_source: record_submit writes `submitted` and `live_orders` in the SAME call before one save, so a coid cannot be in one without the other
an order that leaves live_orders unresolved lands in pending_terminal
a set that cannot be enumerated at all is caught by orders_uncertain
a test asserts those source facts so a future change to record_submit cannot quietly invalidate the reasoning
a_defect_the_probe_found_in_ITSELF.lesson: this is the argument for emitting the gate rather than shipping a prose checklist: a checklist would have looked correct indefinitely

why_it_took_three_deploys.my_error: I set L5_ARM_SWITCH_PROBE with skipDeploys: true, and the write landed AFTER deployment 9968667a had snapshotted its environment.
why_it_took_three_deploys.railway_behaviour_confirmed: a deployment's ENVIRONMENT is snapshotted at creation, and `redeploy` reuses that snapshot along with the build. So neither 9968667a nor its redeploy 0ce088c8 ever had the variable, and the emission returned at its opt-in check.
why_it_took_three_deploys.second_mistake: setting the same value again was a no-op because the value had not changed, so it triggered nothing
why_it_took_three_deploys.resolution: a fresh deploy (d2df888f) takes a new snapshot; the probe emitted 2 minutes after boot
why_it_took_three_deploys.what_I_verified_before_blaming_the_env: the image carries the module (build log: '[35/72] COPY src/l5_arm_switch_gate.py'), the call site is inside heartbeat() with one emit and no early return, and the method is unit-tested

the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.remote_HALT_latch_not_asserted: HALT_NOT_ASSERTED -- CONFIRMED IN PRODUCTION, it is the live blocker right now
the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.latch_unreadable_or_NO_GATE: HALT_STATE_UNESTABLISHED -- three states, not two; an unestablished latch is a blocker, never a pass
the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.orders_uncertain: ORDERS_UNCERTAIN -- the one case where we cannot even enumerate what would cross
the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.inventory_still_exposed: EXPOSURE_OUTSTANDING, from markets_with_exposure() which unions committed, positions, leg_cost, live_orders and pending_terminal minus retired_markets, so it catches residual inventory a quiet order book hides
the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.prior_windows_not_settled_and_retired: WINDOW_NOT_RETIRED, and WINDOW_RETIRED_WITHOUT_SETTLEMENT_RECORD for a retirement carrying no settlement figure. Checked BY NAME and never inferred from a quiet book, because an empty exposure list is also exactly what a window that never traded looks like.
the_four_refusals_the_owner_asked_about.unit_coverage: 33 tests, including a zero settlement value counting as recorded (a DOWN window settles at yes_value 0 and a truthiness test would have read it as missing), blockers accumulating rather than short-circuiting, and the gate writing nothing
